_meta.notes: Slovenia's Zen presence is the One Drop Zen sangha in Ljubljana, in Shōdō Harada Rōshi's Rinzai line; he visits several times a year to lead sesshin.

places.name: One Drop Zendo Slovenija
places.lineage: Rinzai (One Drop Zen / Sōgen-ji; Shōdō Harada Rōshi)
places.notes: Practises in the dance hall of the SGGOŠ on Dunajska cesta. Shōdō Harada Rōshi visits five to six times a year to lead sesshin.
